summary: Veritone, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $50 million of common stock, with UBS, Needham, and Craig-Hallum as sales agents. There is no fixed price, premium, or board recommendation; sales are made at prevailing market prices under Rule 415(a)(4). The filing is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. Investors should monitor market absorption and dilution given the $1.96 stock price as of May 20, 2026.
